verdict.rationale: The docs describe snapshotting a running sandbox to resume later and skip dependency installation (vercel-sandbox-docs-12). They also say creating from a snapshot is faster than starting from scratch (vercel-sandbox-docs-31), and that the filesystem is auto-snapshotted on stop and restored on resume (vercel-sandbox-docs-40, vercel-sandbox-docs-11). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of forking multiple new sandboxes from one snapshot, snapshot API or CLI details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
